mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and rises month-over-month, it indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and corporate earnings pressure, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a contraction in consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue visibility, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with both HOUST and RSAFS declining, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals labor market deterioration that reduces corporate hiring and profit growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS decline, or Rank IC < 0.02 in this regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior month indicates robust manufacturing capacity utilization that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with INDPRO increase, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400.0 thousand units, it signals residential construction weakness that reduces consumer wealth and spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with HOUST < 1400.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in core inflation (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicate aggressive monetary tightening to combat inflation, which raises real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rising, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high industrial production growth regime (INDPRO > 105.0), a slowdown in GDP growth (GDPC1 < 0.5% annualized) signals supply-side bottlenecks that reduce corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with INDPRO > 105.0 and GDPC1 < 0.5% annualized, or Rank IC < 0.02 in this regime.
